name: Billwise Counsel
summary: A fictional time-capture assistant. Sample data for a tool that is not in the sample issue.
paragraphs: Billwise Counsel, in this sample, drafts time entries from email a lawyer already sent. The listing exists so the directory is not only the tools named in one issue.
A real time-capture tool would need the firm's billing rules, and a person would still approve every entry. This page does not offer that product.
whyItMatters: Missed time entries are finished work the firm never bills. Capturing them from mail the lawyer already wrote is one of the clearer ways a tool can change revenue.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Readers comparing a directory page with the issue archive.
